source: client brief — Chemical Resistant Label Solutions

tagline.en: Built to resist harsh chemicals. Designed for reliable identification.
tagline.zh: 耐受严苛化学环境，保障可靠识别。

positioning.en: Chemical exposure can quickly damage ordinary labels, leading to faded prints, adhesive failure, and unreadable barcodes. ETIA Chemical Resistant Label Solutions are engineered for demanding environments where solvents, disinfectants, industrial oils, and process chemicals are routinely used, delivering reliable identification throughout the product lifecycle.
positioning.zh: 化学介质会导致普通标签油墨褪色、胶粘失效及条码无法识别。ETIA 耐化学标签解决方案专为有机溶剂、酒精、消毒剂、工业油污及各类工艺化学品环境设计，在严苛化学工况下持续保持牢固粘接、清晰打印和可靠识别。

heading.zh: 为什么选择耐化学标签？

intro.en: Different chemicals require different label constructions. Selecting the right combination of facestock, adhesive, and print technology helps maintain reliable adhesion, durable print performance, and long-lasting barcode readability — even under repeated chemical exposure.
intro.zh: 不同化学介质对标签的影响各不相同。针对不同应用选择合适的面材、胶粘体系及打印方案，可有效提升标签耐化学性能，确保长期粘附、条码清晰及标识完整。

en: Reliable adhesion on metal, plastic, glass, and coated surfaces
Designed for laboratory, medical, electronics, and industrial applications
zh: 金属、塑料、玻璃等多种基材稳定粘接
面向实验室、医疗、电子及工业应用

en.title: Organic Solvents
en.desc: Designed for environments exposed to aggressive organic solvents that can dissolve inks, soften coatings, and degrade conventional labels.

en.title: Alcohol & Disinfectants
en.desc: Maintains clear identification during repeated alcohol cleaning and routine disinfection.

en.title: Bleach & Oxidizing Disinfectants
en.desc: Designed for repeated exposure to bleach solutions and oxidizing disinfectants without compromising label performance.

en.title: Industrial Oils & Process Fluids
en.desc: Maintains strong adhesion and reliable identification in oil-contaminated manufacturing environments.
en.chemicals: Lubricants • Hydraulic Fluids • Cutting Oils • Brake Fluids

en.title: Acids & Alkalis
en.desc: Designed for harsh chemical processing, surface treatment, and industrial manufacturing environments.
en.chemicals: Hydrochloric Acid • Sulfuric Acid • Sodium Hydroxide • Alkaline Cleaners

zh.title: 有机溶剂
zh.desc: 适用于易溶解油墨、软化涂层、破坏普通标签的强有机溶剂环境。
zh.chemicals: MEK • 丙酮 • 甲苯 • 二甲苯 • DMSO

zh.title: 酒精与消毒剂
zh.desc: 在反复酒精擦拭与日常消毒过程中保持清晰标识。
zh.chemicals: 乙醇 • 甲醇 • 异丙醇（IPA）

zh.title: 漂白剂与氧化性消毒剂
zh.desc: 适用于反复接触漂白剂与氧化性消毒剂的环境，标签性能不受影响。
zh.chemicals: 漂白剂 • 次氯酸钠 • 过氧化氢

zh.title: 工业油污与工艺流体
zh.desc: 在油污污染的制造环境中保持牢固粘接与可靠识别。
zh.chemicals: 润滑油 • 液压油 • 切削液 • 制动液

zh.title: 酸与碱
zh.desc: 适用于严苛化学加工、表面处理及工业制造环境。
zh.chemicals: 盐酸 • 硫酸 • 氢氧化钠 • 碱性清洗剂
